status: Original Wine DDraw1 completes for the first time, but fails acceptance with 816 failures and 6 unreviewed skips.
changes: Validate Clipper allocation identity against live objects before dereferencing a caller pointer; reject copied-vtable fake objects and stale/freed pointers.
Preserve native corrupt-vtable behavior: AddRef on a live object increments, Release returns zero without decrementing until its vtable is restored.
Unregister freed clippers and clear all bound surfaces before freeing the allocation, including cross-owner bindings and intentionally stolen public references.
Return HWND clip bounds in screen coordinates, reject destroyed HWND queries, preserve a saved custom region while tracking a window, and retain outputs/state on invalid calls.

cleanup.scope: Do not mistake process-owner cleanup for complete application Release behavior. API/resource lifetime failures remain.
